import json

input_data = items[0]['json']
text_content_string = input_data['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text']
parsed_text_content = json.loads(text_content_string) # Corrected variable name
output_items = []

for part in parsed_text_content['parts']:
    part_name = part['part_name']
    for dimension in part['dimensions']:
        output_items.append({
            'part_name': part_name,
            'dimension_type': dimension['dimension_type'],
            'feature': dimension['feature'],
            'is_critical_dimension': dimension['is_critical_dimension'],
            'type': dimension['type'],
            'unit': dimension['unit'],
            'value': dimension['value'],
            'tolerance': dimension['tolerance']
        })
return output_items
